name: Lucas Ferreira
life_context: Recent college graduate, lives alone in a studio apartment, works remotely as a junior developer. Moved to SP from a small town 2 years ago.

psychographic.social_style: Prefers small groups, avoids crowded events, needs time to warm up to new people

motivations: make friends in a new city
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Meetup groups were too large and intimidating

name: Maria Gonzalez
life_context: Single mother of a 6-year-old, works as an accountant at a mid-size firm. Lives with her mother who helps with childcare.

psychographic.social_style: Values deep friendships over many acquaintances, prefers daytime or early evening activities

motivations: find other parents for weekend activities
rediscover hobbies she dropped after having her daughter
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Most social apps assume you have free evenings
Events are always at bars — not parent-friendly
No way to filter by schedule availability

name: James Okonkwo
life_context: Freelance graphic designer, lives with two roommates, active social life but wants to expand beyond his current circle.

psychographic.social_style: Loves meeting new people, first to suggest plans, thrives in group settings

frustrations_with_previous_apps: Instagram events are hard to find
No good way to find last-minute activities
expectations: Active community that actually shows up

name: Yuki Tanaka
life_context: Office worker at a logistics company, married with two teenagers. Feels his social circle has shrunk to only work colleagues.

psychographic.social_style: Uncomfortable with casual small talk, prefers structured activities with clear purpose

frustrations_with_previous_apps: Unclear how to start a conversation
expectations: No pressure to be constantly active

name: Priya Sharma
life_context: Final year engineering student, lives in a hostel. Active on social media but struggles with real-life social connections.

psychographic.social_style: Active online persona, quiet in person, needs structured social settings to open up

motivations: find people who share niche interests (anime, poetry)
overcome social anxiety through low-stakes meetups
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Hard to find people with genuinely shared interests
expectations: Option to join events anonymously first

name: Carlos Mendez
life_context: Recently divorced, children are adults living abroad. Retired early from banking. Lots of free time, few social outlets.

psychographic.social_style: Enjoys long conversations, prefers in-person over digital, values respect and mutual interest

frustrations_with_previous_apps: No one his age on most platforms
expectations: Events that match his interests and pace

name: Aisha Bello
life_context: NGO project manager, single, recently relocated from Mombasa. Knows very few people in the city.

psychographic.social_style: Natural connector, enjoys introducing people to each other, prefers meaningful interactions

motivations: build a social network in a new city quickly
explore Nairobi's food and culture scene
frustrations_with_previous_apps: No way to verify if events are real

name: Emma Lindqvist
life_context: UX designer at a startup, lives with her partner. Has friends but wants to expand her social circle beyond the tech bubble.

psychographic.social_style: Selective about social commitments, values quality time, appreciates well-organized events

motivations: meet people outside the tech industry
have a reason to explore her own city
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Too many features crammed into one app
Bad UX makes her cringe professionally

name: David Park
life_context: University freshman, lives in a dorm. Shy and homesick, struggling to make friends on campus.

psychographic.social_style: Lurker by default, contributes when comfortable, prefers expressing himself through creative work

motivations: find a music/band group on campus
meet people without the pressure of approaching strangers
frustrations_with_previous_apps: University apps are dead or clunky
Everyone seems to already have friend groups
expectations: Gentle onboarding that doesn't demand a full profile

name: Sophie Dubois
life_context: Freelance translator, lives alone with two cats. Works from home, days can pass without in-person interaction.

psychographic.social_style: Values solitude but recognizes she needs more human contact, prefers one-on-one or small groups

motivations: find a book club or language exchange
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Forced to upload photos and write witty bios
Algorithms push you toward the most popular people
expectations: Matching by genuine interests not popularity

name: Omar Al-Rashid
life_context: Expat marketing manager, moved from Jordan 6 months ago. Company provides housing but social life is nonexistent.

psychographic.social_style: Networking comes naturally, prefers action over planning, loses interest if things move slowly

motivations: build a social and professional network fast
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Too slow to get value — too many steps before you can do anything

name: Rachel Kim
life_context: High school teacher, married, kids in middle school. Feels she lost her identity outside of 'mom' and 'teacher'.

psychographic.social_style: Warms up slowly, loyal once committed, prefers groups where she can contribute her skills

motivations: find a hiking or running group
meet people who see her as more than her roles
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Privacy concerns — doesn't want students finding her
Apps feel like they're for single people in their 20s

name: Tomás Rivera
life_context: Works at a call center during the day, studies business administration at night. Lives with parents. Limited free time.

psychographic.social_style: Makes friends everywhere but struggles to maintain them due to schedule, prefers quick spontaneous hangouts

frustrations_with_previous_apps: Events require too much advance planning

name: Fatima Zahra
life_context: Pharmacist, lives with family. Conservative household but personally progressive. Wants independence without family conflict.

psychographic.social_style: Opens up in trusted environments, avoids apps where she might be recognized by family acquaintances

motivations: explore interests her family doesn't support (music, art)
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Lack of privacy — anyone can find you

name: Hans Mueller
life_context: Retired engineer, widowed 3 years ago. Lives alone in a house that feels too big. Children live in Germany.

psychographic.social_style: Needs a practical reason to socialize, won't do 'small talk meetups', respects punctuality and clear plans

name: Zara Williams
life_context: Startup founder (ed-tech), lives alone, high-stress lifestyle. Social life collapsed under work pressure.

psychographic.social_style: Wants to be social but cancels plans 50% of the time due to work, frustrated by her own pattern

motivations: meet founders dealing with similar stress
frustrations_with_previous_apps: Guilt from RSVPing and not showing up
